status: PLACEHOLDER. Proves the PNG -> GX texture -> HSD quad path. Not shipping art; the written spec still goes to a human artist.
provenance: 100% generated from the HTML/CSS in pipeline/. No traced, recoloured or referenced Nintendo assets of any kind.

elements.name: panel_bg
elements.format_rationale: Measured: the whole panel is 74 distinct colours after an RGB5A3 quantise, so a CI8 index + RGB5A3 palette reproduces it exactly - byte-identical to straight RGB5A3 at half the memory (512 KB vs 1 MB @2x). Costs one TLUT slot. Fall back to RGB5A3 if TLUT slots are the scarcer resource; the art is unaffected either way.
elements.notes: Caption plate for the loading screen and the trophy-get popup. Diagonal hatch verified against RGB5A3: max delta 8/255, the stripe separation survives at 8.0 luma, no banding.

elements.name: btn_play_ng
elements.format_rationale: Carries text. CMPR chews glyph edges and RGB5A3's 5-bit channels shift the bone-white label off-white. CI8 is out too - hover measures 258 colours, just over the 256 limit.
elements.notes: TexAnim frame 0 of 4 (ng, hover, press, disabled) on one HSD_A_T_TIMG track. Same canvas, same quad, same UV rect: 'press' is offset +8,+8 @2x inside its own image rather than being a smaller texture, so a state change is one animateJoint(joint, TOBJ_MASK, 0) call and nothing moves.

elements.name: row_ng
elements.format_rationale: No text, hard edges, a handful of colours; the slanted ends need only 1-bit alpha, which RGB5A3's opaque mode gives exactly.
elements.notes: Frontend list row, drawn at ~528x34 @1x under the game's own label/value text. 'sel' is the cursor row.

elements.name: cursor_hand
elements.format_rationale: Tiny (16 KB at 2x) and needs clean alpha on a stepped silhouette; CMPR's 1-bit alpha would jag the outline.
elements.notes: Hotspot (14,4) @1x / (28,8) @2x - tip of the index finger.

elements.name: frame_corner_tl
elements.format_rationale: Large transparent region, hard-edged art, no text. Only 5 colours, so CI8 would halve it - but that saves 16 KB for a whole TLUT slot, which is the worse trade. Stay RGB5A3.
elements.notes: 9-slice piece. Emitted per orientation rather than relying on runtime UV flips - collapse to one texture with mirrored UVs if that turns out cheaper.
